segments.source: Onyx describes Power Nap as a pre-roast 50/50 blend of washed Ethiopia Worka and sugarcane-process decaffeinated Colombia Huila. The Colombian component is decaf, while the Ethiopian component is not. Onyx lists mixed varieties and rotating microlots, so the named components and flavor intensity are a checked current record rather than a permanent lot promise. This is a distinct product from Onyx's full-caffeine Monarch and the fully decaffeinated coffees in Coffeedant's decaf guide.

segments.source: The roaster's page shows a 129 mg caffeine figure for a 12 oz prepared cup and explains that its sample measurement uses an instrument after filtering, cooling and sometimes diluting a brew. The displayed value is a roaster sample, not an exact dose for the beans you receive or your grind, dose, brew yield and cup size. A 50/50 blend does not mean every cup has precisely half the caffeine of your previous coffee. If caffeine needs are medically important, seek individual clinical advice rather than relying on this review.

The moderate roast label and recorded ground Agtron #120 add context but cannot predict whether peach will be obvious in your water, grinder and brewer.

segments.source: Owner evidence is sparse and self-selected. One espresso discussion includes an owner who liked Power Nap as an afternoon half-caf but considered it expensive for that role; an older coffee discussion has favorable comments without comparable brew detail. A later espresso owner reported sour, watery shots despite long extractions, which is useful counterevidence but cannot isolate bean, equipment or technique. These accounts show differing experiences, not a consensus flavor score or a guarantee of sleep. Give a first bag a fair trial with a repeatable recipe before ordering multiple boxes.

segments.source: Onyx publishes a Kalita Wave start of 25 g coffee to 400 g water at 205°F, a 1:16 ratio, with a staged bloom and pours. The same brew guide gives an espresso start of 19 g grounds to 45 g beverage, with an Onyx pressure-profile description. These are roaster instructions and do not establish results on a different filter dripper, basket or machine. Use the recipe matching your equipment, record the result and adjust one variable at a time.

segments.source: The fact that Onyx designed the pre-roast blend for both filter and espresso does not remove espresso dialing-in. A 1:16 filter ratio cannot be poured through a portafilter as a shot recipe. A grinder that returns reliably between coarse filter and fine espresso settings is part of the actual two-method setup. If half-caf is mainly for milk drinks, compare the flavor brief against your preferred full-caffeine dark espresso before assuming the same milk balance.

segments.source: Onyx says online coffees are roasted to order and normally dispatched or delivered to its cafes within 24 hours of roasting on Monday through Friday. That is the roaster's direct-order practice, not proof of the date on a reseller's shelf. Check the roast date and condition of the actual box on delivery. Onyx says its opened 10 oz box and rolled inner bag are intended to keep coffee usable for about 30 days; the statement is guidance, not a flavor guarantee.

segments.source: Keep whole beans sealed, away from heat and moisture, and grind close to brewing. Onyx recommends an airtight container for opened 2 lb and 5 lb bags. A large bag is economical only if the household drinks it before it stops meeting its own taste standard. The current product page's cart text does not expose a reliable selected US size and price in the accessible record, so check available pack sizes and the delivered total at checkout.

segments.source: Power Nap earns its place when the pre-blended 50/50 composition, a documented filter and espresso start, and a moderate cocoa-fruit brief simplify a routine you use often. It is less compelling as a one-time novelty or when you require decaf. The official product's dynamic cart did not yield a dependable current price or offer expiry for a selected US pack in this check; this review therefore makes no numeric price, savings or per-cup claim. Compare the exact whole-bean size, subscription terms if chosen, tax and shipping in the live cart.

segments.source: The independent choice is whether you would finish this bag while fresh and enjoy its specific brief. A home-mixed 50/50 combination can give more choice over roasters, but requires buying, storing and dialing in two coffees; Power Nap removes that step. Counter Culture Even Keel is another named half-caf with a different composition and flavor direction. Onyx Monarch is full caffeine and directed toward chocolate-led espresso; it is not a caffeine substitute.

segments.source: Make a first small whole-bean order and note its roast date. Start with Onyx’s published recipe for your usual brewer, then adjust for the actual cup rather than trying filter and espresso on the same grinder setting. The useful test is whether this half-caf bag serves the time of day and flavor preference that led you to it. A measured sample caffeine figure cannot tell you how your own serving will feel.
